Tutorial: <https://vt.tiktok.com/ZSgcb8h28>

*If still happen, **restart pc**

![Attached Image](assets/phantom-blade-zero-4115450_1565306360000811028.png)


![Attached Image](assets/phantom-blade-zero-4115450_1565306360487485582.webp)

---

### ⚠️ Still Getting Errors After Adding & Restarting?

Follow these troubleshooting steps in order:

> **1️⃣ Verify Game File Integrity**
> * Open **Steam** > Right-click the game > **Properties** > **Installed Files** > **Verify integrity of game files**
>
> **2️⃣ Re-apply the Hypervisor Bypass**
> * Run the bypass tool again to re-patch
>
> **3️⃣ Launch Directly from the Game Directory**
> * Navigate to your game installation folder
> * Right-click `hvpnp.bat` > **Run as administrator** 🛡️

---

# Save Game issue?

What did work was the method mentioned by @gokugog, but it needs a bit more clarification on the directory structure. Here is the exact step-by-step that restored my progress:

# 1️⃣ . Navigate to the root save folder:
C:\Games\Phantom Blade Zero\PBZ\ProjectPBZ\Saved\SaveGames
Back up and remove the root save: Find PBZSaveGame.sav in this folder, back it up to your desktop (or another safe folder), and delete it from the original location.

# 2️⃣ . Locate your actual game progress:
Go inside the Steam ID subfolder:
C:\Games\Phantom Blade Zero\PBZ\ProjectPBZ\Saved\SaveGames\Steam\[YourSteamID]\

# 3️⃣ . Copy your active save:
Inside this folder is your regularly updated PBZSaveGame.sav. Copy it.

# 4️⃣ . Paste it into the main save folder:
Drop that copy back into C:\Games\Phantom Blade Zero\PBZ\ProjectPBZ\Saved\SaveGames (the parent directory from Step 1).

Once I launched the game after doing this, my regular save loaded up immediately.
Note: Not entirely sure yet whether the game will automatically update this file or if we have to repeat the copy/paste process after every session.

# HV tools - Legacy

# ⚡ HV Bypass Tool `v1.5.3`

> **Lightweight, portable Windows utility for Hypervisor, VBS & HVCI management.**
*Single-file native `.exe` (`2.2 MB`) • Zero installation • Modern Dark UI*

---

### 🛡️ What is HV Bypass Tool?
A specialized system utility designed to safely inspect, toggle, and configure Windows Virtualization-Based Security (**VBS**), Hypervisor-Protected Code Integrity (**HVCI**), and Test Signing modes—featuring automated bootloader sanitation to prevent boot recovery loops.

---

### ⚙️ Core Functions & Features

- **⚡ 1-Click Auto Setup (`Enter`)**
  Automated setup pipeline: automatically generates a restore snapshot, tunes kernel isolation parameters, and safely disengages VBS/HVCI without causing Windows Hello PIN lockouts.

- **🔄 Safe Revert to Defaults (`R`)**
  Instantly restores stock Windows security parameters for **Valorant / Vanguard / FACEIT**. Purges stale BCD redirects so your PC never gets trapped in recovery loops (`0xc0000189`).

- **💻 Interactive Console (`V`)**
  Launch the low-level `VBS.cmd` maintenance console directly from within the app.

- **📊 Live Ring-0 & Hardware Telemetry**
  Real-time audit of your CPU virtualization (`VT-x / AMD-V`), Secure Boot state, DSE bypass, Test Signing, and HVCI memory isolation.

- **🚀 Direct BIOS / UEFI Reboot**
  1-click restart directly into motherboard UEFI/BIOS firmware without spamming keyboard keys.

- **💾 System Restore Point Guard**
  Create immediate native Windows System Restore snapshots before applying modifications.

- **🔄 Built-In Hot-Swap Auto-Updater**
  Verifies releases against the repository and self-updates in seconds with zero manual downloads.

---

### ⌨️ Quick Hotkeys
- `Enter` ➔ Run 1-Click Auto Setup
- `R` ➔ Safe Revert to Stock Settings
- `V` ➔ Open Interactive VBS Script

desc: 🛠️ AnyDesk Reset & Toolkit
author: Ryunosuke
content:
# Anydesk Toolkit

# 🛠️ AnyDesk Reset & Toolkit

A simple, lightweight utility to reset your AnyDesk ID, clean configuration caches, or download the latest official release.

### 📌 What It Does
- ⚡ **Reset AnyDesk ID**: Stops background processes/services and purges old cache files so AnyDesk generates a brand-new ID.
- ⬇️ **Download Latest**: Automatically pulls the newest official `AnyDesk.exe` from anydesk.com with live progress.
- 🚀 **Full Reset & Update**: One-click wipe + auto-download + instant launch with a fresh ID.

---

### 🚀 How to Use
1. Run **`AnyDeskTool.exe`** (or `anydesk reset.bat`).
2. Accept the **Run as Administrator** prompt when asked.
3. Pick your option:
   - Click **`Reset ID`** if you just need a new ID.
   - Click **`Download`** if you need the latest AnyDesk executable.
   - Click **`Reset & Update`** to wipe old data and launch the newest version.

---

### ⚙️ How It Works (Behind the Scenes)
1. Safely shuts down running AnyDesk instances and the Windows background service.
2. Deletes old identity tokens from:
   - `C:\ProgramData\AnyDesk`
   - `%APPDATA%\AnyDesk`
3. Restarts the service and launches AnyDesk, which registers as a brand new client.

> ⚠️ **Note:** Resetting will clear your recent session history and saved favorites.

> On v1 release, i forgot to re-add a static SteamID into configs.user.ini which causes the emu (or the game) to regenerate random SteamID upon game exit that causes the existing save files to not get loaded on the next game boot. Re-adding it back in v2 fixes it.
> 
> But if you've already progressed enough in the campaign and want to restore your old progress without starting over, then follow this steps:
> 
> - Navigate to "C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\Activision\Call of Duty\players"
> - Take a note of the SteamID of the numbered folder (the oldest created) that contains your already existing save files
> - Open configs.user.ini in both "sp26\steam_settings\" and "sp26\steam_settings\local_saves\settings\" and put the SteamID that you've noted earlier on "account_steamid"
> - Done

### 📥 How to Restore Your Old Save Files

**Step 1: Locate your save folder**
Head over to this directory on your PC:
`C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\Activision\Call of Duty\players`

**Step 2: Find your original SteamID**
Look through the numbered folders inside and find the **oldest created folder**. The folder name is your original **SteamID**—make a note of it!

**Step 3: Update your config files**
Open `configs.user.ini` in **both** of these locations using any text editor (like Notepad):
1. `sp26\steam_settings\`
2. `sp26\steam_settings\local_saves\settings\`

Find the line reading `account_steamid` and replace it with the **SteamID** you noted down in Step 2. Save the files.

**Step 4: You're all set!**
Boot up the game, and your campaign progress should load right back up. Let us know if you run into any issues! 🎮✨
